claude.performance_metric: operationally successful ~25 years; unwound April 1, 2010 amid GM bankruptcy, ~$281M severance to ~4,700 workers
claude.rationale: gap_45=0: Section 2 shows the dual-branded product (T4) and the Toyota Production System process (T5) were installed together and, per Section 4 P4, "TPS process and dual-branded product co-functioned productively for ~25 years." gap_56=0: Section 2 shows TPS process (T5) and the rehired UAW workforce (T6) were aligned coherently, transforming culture into one of GM's best factories. p4_pathway=0 and p5_pathway=0: Section 4 explicitly documents "none" at both the T4<->T5 and T5<->T6 interfaces, with termination caused by GM's exogenous 2009 bankruptcy/abandonment rather than any tier-transfer defect.

gemini.performance_metric: operated as efficiently as Toyota's Japanese facilities
gemini.rationale: The dossier documents a joint venture where Toyota's production processes (T5) and GM's former workforce (T6) were successfully integrated without structural gaps at closing (gap_45=0, gap_56=0). Post-deal, there was no product-process disruption (p4_pathway=0) or process-organization fracture (p5_pathway=0); the plant operated efficiently for ~25 years until GM's bankruptcy.

Section 4 explicitly codes P4=0, P5=0, t1_archetype=0, t2_model=0 with terminal cause exogenous (GM bankruptcy).
